# Commonplace

A Plotform studio adaptation of Launch UI.

Serve this directory with any static HTTP server, for example `python3 -m http.server 8080`, then open http://localhost:8080. There is no compilation or dependency installation.

Edit index.html, assets/style.css and assets/site.js. All images and fonts are local.

Read VENDOR-NOTES.md for provenance, included licenses and functionality limits. The original framework source is preserved in launch-ui-original-source.zip.
